proposed.text: Why are many structural steel connections made on site with bolts rather than welds?

options.text: Bolting supports faster site assembly and reduces field quality-control risk compared with welding on site
Bolts are only decorative and do not affect structural assembly
Bolts eliminate the need for connection design
Bolting is used only after occupancy

proposed.rationale: Bolting supports faster site assembly and reduces field quality-control risk compared with welding on site. The audited sources support steel connection behavior, on-site bolting, and high-strength friction grip bolt use without relying on unsupported grade tables.
